origin.problem: On a phone, rotating the building makes the image become conspicuously blurry or low resolution, producing an uncomfortable visual transition.

requiredObservations: At least one actually presented frame during the gesture
For each sampled motion camera, a settled replay at the identical camera and sampling grid
A declared equality or image-difference rule between each motion frame and its same-camera settled replay
Inter-present gaps and release-to-complete latency reported without silently inventing an acceptance threshold
Physical-device evidence kept distinct from browser mobile emulation
failIf: Only gesture/rest configuration widths are compared
No frame is proven to have been presented while the pointer was moving
A measured latency is reported without a declared acceptance bound and called responsive

evidenceUpdates.verifiedSubclaim: Latest camera intent is the first completed presentation after release; no stale intent is presented after release.
evidenceUpdates.unverifiedClaim: At least one clear frame is presented while the gesture is in progress.

activation: Requires targeted Mother acknowledgement plus a successful minimal replay; this file alone does not change any production gate.
